# EX05: solid ball lens + aperture + actual entry/exit Snell/Fresnel ray power.
# Orbit/zoom OUT+IN with the existing camera. Edit aperture/index then Run.
# Collimated incoherent rays; no coherent laser or framebuffer ray tracing.
optics: .physics.optics
:.math
sphere_x(theta: num, phi: num) -> num: cos(theta) * sin(phi)
sphere_y(theta: num, phi: num) -> num: sin(theta) * sin(phi)
sphere_z(phi: num) -> num: 0.8 + cos(phi)

point2(x: num, y: num) -> [num: 2]: [x, y]
point3(x: num, y: num, z: num) -> [num: 3]: [x, y, z]
scene():
    view: .ui.viewport
    index: 1.5
    aperture: 0.2
    top: optics.ball_lens_ray(aperture, 1, index, 1.5)
    middle: optics.ball_lens_ray(0, 1, index, 1.5)
    bottom: optics.ball_lens_ray(-aperture, 1, index, 1.5)
    top_points: top.points >> [$.0, $.1, 0.8]
    middle_points: middle.points >> [$.0, $.1, 0.8]
    bottom_points: bottom.points >> [$.0, $.1, 0.8]
    theta: [0..48] * 2 * pi / 48
    phi: [0..24] * pi / 24
    x: sphere_x(theta_u, phi_v)
    y: sphere_y(theta_u, phi_v)
    z: sphere_z(phi_v)
    floor: [[-3.5, -2, -0.25], [2, -2, -0.25], [2, 2, -0.25], [-3.5, 2, -0.25]]
    faces: [[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]]
    aperture_top: [[-2, aperture, 0.3], [-2, 0.7, 0.3], [-2, 0.7, 1.3], [-2, aperture, 1.3]]
    aperture_bottom: [[-2, -0.7, 0.3], [-2, -aperture, 0.3], [-2, -aperture, 1.3], [-2, -0.7, 1.3]]
    f: optics.fresnel(1, index, 1)
    view.set_geom_options(background: [0.025, 0.035, 0.06, 1], render_options: (show_light_markers: true, light_flares: true, light_marker_size: 0.1))
    view.add(p: floor_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "bench-shadow-receiver", color: [0.16, 0.23, 0.31, 1], roughness: 0.65)
    view.add(x: x_uv, y: y_uv, z: z_v, id: "solid-lens", color: [0.3, 0.65, 0.95, 1], optical_index: index, reflectivity: f.rs, transparency: 0.8, roughness: 0, casts_shadow: false)
    view.add(p: aperture_top_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "aperture-upper", color: [0.35, 0.4, 0.48, 1], roughness: 0.4, casts_shadow: true)
    view.add(p: aperture_bottom_up, faces: faces_uv, id: "aperture-lower", color: [0.35, 0.4, 0.48, 1], roughness: 0.4, casts_shadow: true)
    view.add(p: top_points_uc, id: "upper-transmitted-ray", color: [1, 0.65, 0.12, top.state.0], w: 3)
    view.add(p: middle_points_uc, id: "axis-transmitted-ray", color: [1, 0.65, 0.12, middle.state.0], w: 3)
    view.add(p: bottom_points_uc, id: "lower-transmitted-ray", color: [1, 0.65, 0.12, bottom.state.0], w: 3)
    view.add_light(id: "visible-illuminator", kind: "spot", pos: [-2.5, -1, 3], target: [0, 0, 0], color: [1, 0.85, 0.55, 1], intensity: 8, source_radius: 0.12, spread: 1, inner_cone_deg: 20, outer_cone_deg: 35, range: 12, casts_shadow: true, show_marker: true)
    view.add_camera(pos: [4, -6, 4], target: [-0.5, 0, 0.7], up: [0, 0, 1], fov: 42)
    view.push(x_label: "x (m)", y_label: "y (m)", z_label: "z (m)")
    view.show()
    :: optics.detector(top.state)
    :: top.rejected_power
scene()
